verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at docs.cfo.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that indexes Markdown versions of the docs, and cfo.ai/llms.txt also serves product content. The docs include agent-specific pages (agents/index.md, agents/mcp-tools.md) and a skill.md that users paste into Claude Code or Codex, so an agent can be pointed directly at machine-readable docs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent actually consuming these docs or the skill.md (skill.md itself was not probed).
